name: Aurevo
summary: Personal-brand coach site on near-white with charcoal and an electric lime accent, a three-column photo hero and alternating lime and charcoal framed cards for offers and case studies.

fonts.pairing: single friendly grotesk family: 700 for all headings, 400 at 18px for body, no caps labels

signature: three-column hero: headline left, tall rounded portrait centre with floating topic chips, social proof and a sage free-resources card right
offer cards framed by a thick lime or charcoal border with a white inner panel and photo, stacking sticky as you scroll
case study cards alternating lime and charcoal with oversized blue or lime result figures beside a white quote panel
charcoal pill buttons with a white circular arrow cap
imagery: bright lifestyle photography of creators, laptops, video calls and small workshops; round avatar portraits
layout_grid: 1100px content, 3-column hero, 2-column card interiors (copy panel plus photo), sticky left heading beside a scrolling card column, 30px card radius
